metaTitle: Custom Scrub Lapel Pins | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom scrub lapel pins for healthcare teams. Perfect for branding scrubs with durable, colorful designs from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom scrub lapel pins are a practical way to add personality and professionalism to healthcare uniforms. Unlike standard lapel pins, these are designed to withstand frequent washing and daily wear on scrubs, making them ideal for hospitals, clinics, and medical offices. Choose from soft enamel or printed finishes in sizes like 1 inch or 1 1/4 inches to display your logo, department name, or recognition awards. They attach securely and stay vibrant through repeated use.
heroAltText: Custom scrub lapel pins in soft enamel finish with medical cross design on blue scrubs
